He performed with the Standard Bank National Schools’ Big Band, in 2007, and at Paul Bothner’s Drum Day, in 2010. He drummed for the North Sea Big Band, in 2010, and followed up by performing at the prestigious Cape Town International Jazz Festival, with Spha Mdlalose. Other notable work includes an appearance on Idols star Unathi’s album, entitled: ‘With Love’, and on Sowers of the Word’s debut album: ‘God of Wonders’. He has a background in Rock, Pop, Swing, Latin jazz, Bebop jazz, R ‘n’ B, Hip Hop and Gospel, in live performance, studio session work and educationally.

He currently performs with the Jimmy Nevis band, electro-pop quartet TheCity and SA ska band Trenton and Free Radicals.

**Contact Details**

To book Ruby Crowie as a session musician or simply for additional information, please email[kim.muller@hotmail.com](mailto:kim.muller@hotmail.com.)

This hip, young virtuoso started playing piano at the age of four!! To his fans this would come as no surprise! Kyle is a well-schooled prodigy… He went on to study piano and voice as subjects, before leaving for Greece, as a youth, where he performed on the Olympia Countess, as it sailed around the globe!! He’s been musical director to many productions, at venues such as the Cape Town International Convention Center and Grand West Casino, amongst many others.

He’s also a producer, session musician, highly trained vocalist, multi-instrumentalist and has had lots of radio airplay. The Kyle Petersen Band features his university trained brother, session star, Darren Petersen, who’s also travelled and performed, much like Kyle.

Follow Kyle on [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/kylepetersenmusic) or check out his [website](https://www.kylepetersenmusic.com/).

**After discovering that he loved writing songs in high school and taking some guitar lessons, Jesse could sense that he was embarking on a journey to follow his dreams.**

Jesse has had a career that many singer-songwriters would love. He has pursued his music with single-minded determination, and it has definitely paid off.

One of his first big miles stones on his journey was winning a national talent competition. After that there was no stopping Jesse! Not only did he get a mjor record deal, but Jesse went on to form the Jesse Jordan Band. The Jesse Jordan Band consisted of Alex Power on keys, Heindrich Schultz on guitar, JP Crouch on drums and Sheree Power on Rhythm guitar.

So far Jesse has managed to record four albums, but that’s just a start! He’s still in the prime of his career, and it would seem as though nothing is slowing him down.

Over the years he has played countless live shows; ranging from music festivals and parties to selling out venues. He has honed his skill as a performer and audiences always leave with a smile on their faces. Jesse is known to give 150% to every performance!

After years with the Jesse Jordan Band, Jesse has started a new solo journey. It’s just him, a guitar and his life experiences. He has spent the last two years writing new songs which explore the lessons he’s learned on his journey.

This new solo project is all about story-telling in the style of old-school singer-songwriters and bluesmen. It’s raw, personal and real. In his music, you will find a hint of Michael Buble meets Maroon5, but the sound is still unmistakably Jesse Jordan.

#### **Faith Endorsement**

In September 2017 Jesse Jordan was officially endorsed by Faith Guitars and Paul Bothner Music.

Faith guitars all have a rich and unique tone which perfectly matches the rawness of Jesse’s stories. It is a perfect partnership of tone and perfection.

To keep up with Jesse, go to his [Facebook page](https://www.facebook.com/jessejordanofficial/) or [website](http://jordanjesse348.wixsite.com/jessejordan/my-story) and give him a like and a listen.

CCFM (Cape Community FM) is a 24-hour, non-profit, community radio station serving the people of Cape Town. We play a mix of contemporary Christian music, combined with compelling chat, views and interviews. Not to mention up-to-the-minute news, weather and traffic information. CCFM was the first community radio station and has been on the airwaves for over 18 years, starting as Radio Fish Hoek in 1993. We currently broadcast from our building in Muizenberg on 107.5 FM in the Greater Cape Town and on 96.7 FM in the Fish Hoek valley.

Tunes is a rehearsal studio that acts in the interest of local music by providing affordable practice space, good quality reference rehearsal recordings, drum lessons and retailing in musical accessories including guitar strings, drumsticks and larger items that can be ordered from Paul Bothner. We recently added new items to our stock such as drum skins, cymbals, guitar and bass pedals. We also stock electric, acoustic and bass guitars.

Tunes is open for bookings seven days a week from 08h00 to 24h00. Bookings can be made by contacting Jean on 082 7704798 or by e-mail, tunesstudio@gmail.com

With studios in Cape Town & Johannesburg and branches in Lagos and Dar Es Salaam, Sound & Motion Studios is a multi-purpose audio solution covering both POST PRODUCTION AND MUSIC PRODUCTION. With a team of highly skilled engineers, producers and composers in our stable, our facilities offer analogue warmth and character, guaranteed through beautiful mixing consoles and tape machines, that forms the soul of music productions, as well as the digital accuracy and recall requirements for film, tv and corporate productions.

SoundHouse is a music educational vision. Designed not only to educate microcosmically but to facilitate the teaching of musical concepts through music technology. A particular focus of this vision is on music experimentation, composition, learning and recording, digital media, such as picture stories, music videos and digital mash-ups.

Talented singer/songwriter Louise Day has been captivating audiences and stealing hearts since a young age. A true Cape Town girl through and through, her unique blend of Folk/Pop, delivered by her outstanding lingering vocals, have been showcased at some of the trendiest and musically influential venues in South Africa.

Her music career started professionally when an itch to explore the international music scene lead her to the United States where she settled for a year in Colorado. There she began performing at a premiere live music venue, “Bellyup” (www.bellyupaspen.com), regularly opening for visiting internationally recognized artists, including the likes of the acclaimed ‘Grace Potter & The Nocturnals’ and ‘The English Beat’. q

This exposure resulted in a tremendous demand for her talents, and her remaining time was spent performing as a Fender Musician at the Winter X Games and Tempe Music Festival in Arizona, performing on the same stage as many international artists such as John Mayer and The Fray. She also made her mark on Fender USA when she was approached to endorse their new range of guitars for women. Since her return to South Africa, Louise and her band launched their very successful debut album “Chasing the Wind “ followed by a second album “Swallowed by the City” which was produced by music legend Theo Crous of the Springbok Nude Girls.

The album went on to receive a SAMA (South African Music Awards) nomination for best Pop Album. After a busy time of live performances, Louise and her band are back in the studio working on their third album which will be released in 2014.

Follow Louise on [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/louise.day.18) or check out her [website](http://louisedayband.com/).

Lance has what people in the drumming community call Gospel Chops. This is a combination of intense technical playing and drum patterns which have big funk and hip hop swinging grooves. He is currently one of the top Gospel Chops drummers in Cape Town and is already counted as one of the top drummers in South Africa.He runs his own music school where he works with and teaches young children to play music.

He’s been teaching around Cape Town and its surrounds. Lance studied at Cape Music Institute where he played in the Camillo Lombard Trio and Donveno Prins Band for 2 years. Since then, Lance has been a session musician and has worked with top artists like Camillo Lombard, Donveno Prins, Loyiso Bala, Allou April, Joyous Celebration, Ernie Smith, Sammy Webber, and One Accord.He has two drumming instructional DVDs: “Playing over the Groove” and “Beyond Playing”.

**Contact Details**

For bookings contact Mark on 083 3130 233 or Beryl on 073 0122 870

Beau Soleil offers tuition on all the instruments of the orchestra, namely flute, oboe, clarinet, saxophone, bassoon, violin, viola, cello, double bass, trumpet, trombone, French horn, euphonium, tuba and percussion. An Open Evening is held once a year, during which most of the instruments are demonstrated and prospective pupils and parents have an opportunity to learn more about Beau Soleil. A number of these instruments are available for hire for a limited period.

The Gryphon Music Academy is a guitar school based in Plumstead, Cape Town. We offer guitar lessons, bass lessons, song writing courses and music theory courses Our Motto is “Turning players into musicians”. At the Gryphon Music Academy we believe in teaching players of all levels to not just play the instrument, but to think about the entire scope of the instrument in the context of music. Besides learning the practical side of playing, you will also learn music theory, song writing and instrument maintenance.

Rockschool is the leading accredited provider of rock & pop exams worldwide. We offer Graded Music Exams in the principal rock instruments and Diplomas in Teaching and Performance. Rockschool produces and examines unique music qualifications that are taught by independent teachers in schools, colleges and music centres all over the world. Rockschool music qualifications are practical, flexible and fun and are open to musicians of all ages and abilities.

Offering lessons in:

Vocal, Guitar, Piano, Drums, Bass Guitar, Violin, Cello, Saxophone, Oboe, Clarient, & Flute, and with lessons available in Bryanston, Fourways, Centurion and Kemptopn Park, the Global House of Music is your one stop music lesson option in the Joberg area. They even offer home lessons. [Check out there website](http://globalhouseofmusic.co.za/contact-us/) to make a booking or call them directly on: 083 959 3782

A high energy electronicore band focused on bombastic theatrical performances, Set For The Sky have been making waves all across the local scene with electric live performances and a high quality sound. Consummate professionals, they have been gigging since 2013 and have continued to grow their name in the South African music market, with a highly acclaimed debut album, “The Machine”, released in 2015 and two video singles “Live Like You’re on Fire” and “The Secret Season”.

They have played numerous shows around the country including slots on many festivals and tours, they do not settle for mediocre, whether in their performance or their music, and will continue to provide an exceptional experience for their fans.

Follow the band on [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/SetForTheSky/) or check out their [website](https://www.setforthesky.com/)

BULLETSCRIPT is a band with a clear message – open your eyes to the world around you, and question everything, taking nothing, and nobody, for granted.

The band consists of a full compliment of seasoned performers from the Cape Town metal scene. A band that enjoys pushing the envelope, placing great emphasis on solid song writing, stellar stage performance and a delivery so intense that your neck will be in a constant state of headbanging ecstasy.

Combining the skills of Ian Watson (Vocals), Jacques Hugo (Guitar), Oliver Saggerson (Guitar), JJ du Toit (Bass) and Kyle Curran (Drums), BULLETSCRIPT is ready to spread the word, take no prisoners and have a great time!

Follow the band on [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/BULLETSCRIPT/)

The Mercury is a top class music venue in Cape Town, right up the road from the Cape Technikon and close to the city itself. Incorporating two venues playing a large mix of music, it is one of the best places in Cape Town to hear South African tunes.

This venue is actually two in one: the Live and the Lounge areas. With its own in-house sound and lighting system, the Mercury has built a superb reputation and a loyal clientele during its 10-year existence.

Located in the old historic area of District Six, also known as Zonnebloem, it hosts live music entertainment ranging in style from rock, hip-hop and pop to jazz, world music and electronica.

Mercury’s upstairs Live venue has a capacity of over 600, and has seen most of South Africa’s top acts perform on its stage. Foosball and pool tables provide a diversion in between performances. With regular specials and promotions on offer, it’s a firm favourite with live music aficionados.

The smaller, downstairs Lounge venue has capacity for approximately 150 people, and hosts DJ parties and student nights on certain evenings. Staying open till the wee hours, the lounge is also a favourite late-night dancing and chill-out spot for patrons from other clubbing venues nearby.

Owned by former band and road manager Kevin Winder, the Mercury has a solid reputation for providing the best quality sound in a convenient and well-equipped venue. This ethos extends to making sure that only the best bands, both established and up-and-coming, are invited to play, resulting in top quality music nights.

The venue has a relaxed and friendly vibe, with good security and, a rarity amongst live music venues, excellent service. Dedicated to supporting South African music, it’s one of the best live music venues in the country.

NueLight Productions is the brainchild and passion of Julita Kok. NueLight produces superb musical showcases bringing the very best of South African talent to the fore. Producer of showcases such as ‘Christmas with GOD TV’, Blue Rock Gospel Fest, BAHI Healing Concert and many others, NueLight is definitely making its mark on the international and local Christian Music Industry. Entrepreneur, producer, events coordinator and artist developer, Julita Kok, an accomplished vocalist herself, has made excellence a priority for NueLight, its artists and productions. Maintaining this high calibre by associating with the crème dela crème of the Christian Music Industry.

In De Kuilen street Kuilsriver, the average passer-by may be pleasantly surprised by what is heard when passing number 15. This building houses a premier music school within the community: Cape Music Institute. The sounds of guitar, bass-guitar, drums, keyboards, saxophones, and voices fill the air, making it an educational, entertaining and fun atmosphere. The concept of Cape Music Institute was birthed during a meeting in 2005 between Camillo Lombard, Ezra Delport, and Gary Thomas and, is currently in its fourth year of existence. Each individual contributed his own vision and ideas of what the school should be and, the outcome was a combined vision of a higher education school of music, emphasized in three categories: performance, production and business. The “seed” for Cape Music Institute, however, had been “planted” in the three Founders independently.

Do you have a desire to play the drums or improve your guitar skills or another band instrument? If so, then M&M is the perfect part-time Music Academy for you. We have students that attend the academy from the Parklands, Table View, West Beach, Melkbos and Milnerton area. We offer musical training in all the popular band instruments from beginner to advanced. Why don’t you visit the “Instrument” tab to learn more about our drum, guitar, bass, piano/keyboard or vocal courses. We also offer a full digital recording studio operating on Cubase, Presonus, Rode and Alesis equipment, should you wish to lay some music tracks or follow your personal development at M&M.

COPA currently has four campuses around South Africa. Read about each of them below: Cape Town COPA’s Cape Town campus boasts the largest Live Performance Venue of all campuses. Facilities include rehearsal rooms, a demo room (production suite), a resource centre and a recording studio also hosting an Apple Mac equipped technology room. Johannesburg COPA’s Johannesburg campus is the largest of all campuses with over 300 students. Facilities include a resource centre, rehearsal rooms, demo rooms (production suites), an Apple Mac equipped technology room, recording studio and a Live Performance Venue. Pretoria COPA’s Pretoria campus is very centrally located. Facilities include a resource centre, rehearsal rooms, demo rooms (production suites), a recording studio also hosting an Apple Mac equipped technology room and a Live Performance Venue. Kwa-Zulu Natal (KZN) COPA’s KZN campus is the newest campus. Facilities include a resource centre, rehearsal rooms, a demo room (production suite), a recording studio and a Live Performance Venue.

The Athlone Academy of Music (AAM) is a non-profit organisation established in 1994 with the sole aim of providing music tuition within the Athlone area. This initiative has now expanded and has grown to include the greater Athlone community residing along the Klipfontein corridor including Langa, Gugulethu, Khayelitsha, Mitchells Plain, Retreat, Steenberg, Atlantis and Malmesbury to name but a few. The communities in and around Athlone have tried but there has not always been a cohesive attempt to make sure that music education is not lost to our children. Music tuition has shown to help with discipline, motivation and a sense of belonging. Three basic values that children from the poorer disadvantaged communities need plenty of. We all know that these communities suffer under the scourge of substance abuse, disease, abuse against women and children and a general decay of the social fibre in society. This social decay is largely a result of unemployment, poverty and idleness. We at the Academy feel obliged to create opportunities for children in the communities we serve to be active in music education and in so doing, eradicate some of the social pathologies we are faced with on a daily basis.

Music is about way more than solo acts. School of Rock Claremont is as focused on community, teamwork, and friendships as it is on inspiring awesome music. Through our performance-based approach, we foster an inclusive community of rockers in Claremont to build a unique type of confidence only gained through cool, real life experiences. Whether we’re in serious shredding-mode or just jamming along with the band, our team spurs the growth of real, practical skills for music-minded students.

At School of Rock Claremont, we believe everyone deserves to have fun and feel like a rock star. Visit us and get a feel for the awesome opportunities your child has waiting just around the corner.

For some people, music is all about technical mastery and learning songs written by various composers. But most musicians want to perfect the instrument in a way that allows them to express themselves through song.

There is a misconception among many people that unless you’re a natural-born songwriter, you’ll never really be any good at it. This is, of course, simply not true.

If you want to be a songwriter, you only need to do two things.

1) Learn the fundamentals of music theory and the rules of writing songs.

2) Practice. Remember that the first few hundred songs you write won’t be “the best” songs ever, but that’s why you need to keep working on it.

We can’t help you much with the second point, but if you want to learn the fundamentals of songwriting, then you should consider enrolling in the Cape Town School of Songwriting.

For more information, please contact Elaine Ridgway (082 7773133) or email clive@songwriters.co.za

###### about us

## Drizit Environmental is South Africa’s most established pollution control company

Delivering reliable, compliant, and effective environmental solutions since 1975. With nearly five decades of hands-on experience, we have built a reputation for rapid response, technical expertise, and unwavering commitment to environmental protection.

From emergency spill response to long-term environmental rehabilitation, we provide end-to-end pollution control solutions across South Africa and internationally, including Africa, the Middle East, and Europe.

![Pollution control solutions](https://drizit.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/Drizit-Homepage-02.png)

![pollution control company](https://drizit.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/Drizit-Homepage-01.png)

## Comprehensive Pollution Control Services

Drizit is far more than a spill response contractor. We offer a full spectrum of pollution control services, products, and compliance solutions designed to support operations before, during, and after environmental incidents.

## Our Core Offerings

## 24/7 Emergency Spill Response

Immediate, nationwide response to oil, chemical, fuel, and hazardous material spills on land, in ports, and in marine environments.

[View Service](https://drizit.com/24-7-emergency-spill-response/)

## Specialised Industrial Cleaning

High-risk and specialist cleaning services for industrial plants, tanks, pipelines, refineries, and contaminated industrial facilities.


[View Service](https://drizit.com/specialised-industrial-cleaning/)

## Spill Kits, Absorbents, and Degreasers

A complete range of compliant spill kits, absorbent products, degreasers, and response equipment tailored to site-specific risks.



[View Service](https://drizit.com/spill-kits-absorbents-and-degreasers/)

## Oil/Water and Skimmer Separators

Design, supply, and ongoing support of separation systems to manage hydrocarbons, effluents, and contaminated water.



[View Service](https://drizit.com/oil-water-skimmers-and-separators/)

## Bioremediation and Rehabilitation

Environmentally responsible remediation and rehabilitation of contaminated soil, water, and sites using proven biological processes

[View Service](https://drizit.com/bioremediation-and-rehabilitation/)

## Waste Collection Solutions

Safe handling, transport, and compliant disposal of hazardous and non-hazardous waste in line with environmental legislation.


[View Service](https://drizit.com/waste-management/)

## Specialised Compliance Products

Pollution prevention, containment, and compliance solutions that help clients meet regulatory and ESG requirements.



[View Service](https://drizit.com/specialised-compliance-products/)

[Our Products](https://drizit.com/products/)

## What Sets Drizit Apart

### Experience That Can’t Be Replicated

With 50 years of pollution control experience, Drizit has successfully managed virtually every environmental incident and industrial challenge.

### Extensive Approved Vendor Network

We hold over 500 vendor numbers across major industries, continuously expanding our approved supplier and service-provider footprint.

### Trusted by Industry Leaders

Our long-standing client relationships span mining, oil and gas, chemical manufacturing, logistics, ports, and heavy industry, organisations that demand proven performance and compliance.

### Skilled, Diverse People

Our teams bring a broad, multi-disciplinary skillset, combining decades of field experience with technical, environmental, and safety expertise.

### Accredited, Certified, and Compliant

Drizit operates to the highest standards of health, safety, environment, and quality (HSEQ) compliance, ensuring safety, quality, and environmental responsibility.

### Proudly South African

We are a Level 1 BBBEE contributor, committed to transformation, local expertise, and sustainable growth.

[More About Drizit](https://drizit.com/about/)

## Our Purpose  is simple but powerful

Drizit strives to protect people, preserve the environment, safeguard property, and secure the future.

## Industries We Serve

Drizit supports organisations operating in high-risk, regulated, and environmentally sensitive environments, including:

[View Industry Solutions](https://drizit.com/services/)

[View Industry Solutions](https://drizit.com/services/)

#### [Mining](https://drizit.com/\#collapse-1221)

Pollution control for tailings, effluents, chemical reagents, slurry transport, bulk chemical storage, and tailings dams, supporting compliance and operational continuity.

[**read more**](https://drizit.com/mining-industry/)

#### [Oil and Gas](https://drizit.com/\#collapse-1222)

Refineries, depots, fuel terminals, bulk fuel transporters, and service stations requiring tank cleaning, spill containment, oil spill response, and regulatory compliance.

[**read more**](https://drizit.com/oil-and-gas-operators/)

#### [Chemical Manufacturing and Processing](https://drizit.com/\#collapse-1223)

Facilities handling solvents, hazardous liquids, and industrial chemicals, requiring containment systems, waste management, emergency response, and industrial cleaning.

[**read more**](https://drizit.com/petrochemical-industry/)

#### [Transport and Logistics](https://drizit.com/\#collapse-1224)

Tanker fleets, rail, marine, and hazardous material transporters needing emergency spill preparedness, tanker cleaning, and pollution control readiness.

Ports, Marine, and Shipping: Ports, terminals, and shipping operations exposed to marine spill risk, supported by oil booms, skimmers, marine spill response, and port booming solutions.

[**read more**](https://drizit.com/logistics/)

#### [Industrial and Manufacturing Operations](https://drizit.com/\#collapse-1225)

Heavy industry, construction, asbestos removal, and manufacturing plants managing hazardous waste, effluents, and industrial contamination risks.

[**read more**](https://drizit.com/industrial-sector/)

#### [Compliance-Driven Organisations](https://drizit.com/\#collapse-1226)

Companies operating under environmental licences, mining regulations, or environmental, social, and governance (ESG) mandates, relying on Drizit to prevent fines, shutdowns, and environmental liability.

#### [Insurance](https://drizit.com/\#collapse-1227)

Environmental incidents carry significant financial, legal and reputational risk. For insurers, underwriters and claims managers, rapid, professional response is critical to limiting loss exposure and ensuring compliant, well-documented remediation.

[**read more**](https://drizit.com/insurance/)

## The Longopac® bag cassette

Longopac is a waste management system based on a continuous plastic liner. The system allows users to create custom-sized waste bags by pulling out the desired length of film from the bag cassette, sealing it with two cable ties, and cutting between them. This way, the filled bag is sealed, and a new one is instantly ready for use.

The system is highly efficient, convenient, and environmentally beneficial, making it ideal for use across various industries and applications in waste handling.

# Australia's \#1 Wholesaler for Packaging Supplies

Signet is your go-to destination for all packaging supplies online. We
offer a vast selection of products, including
[cartons & boxes](https://www.signet.net.au/packaging/boxes-containers.html),
[mailers](https://www.signet.net.au/packaging/mailroom-shipping/mail-bags.html),
[mailroom & shipping supplies](https://www.signet.net.au/packaging/mailroom-shipping.html),
[packing tape](https://www.signet.net.au/packaging/packaging-tapes-adhesives.html),
[pallet wrap](https://www.signet.net.au/packaging/pallet-wrap-stretch-films.html), [strapping](https://www.signet.net.au/packaging/strapping.html), and
more. Shop confidently at Signet with same-day dispatch and free shipping on
orders over $200 (ex GST).
Enjoy bulk-buy discounts and the convenience of always having
products in stock and delivered on time.


## [Packaging Supplies](https://www.signet.net.au/packaging.html)

Discover Signet's Extensive Range of
[Packaging Supplies:](https://www.signet.net.au/packaging.html)

- **[Cartons & Boxes](https://www.signet.net.au/packaging/boxes-containers.html):**
Explore our diverse range of
[shipping cartons and mailing boxes](https://www.signet.net.au/packaging/boxes-containers.html), available in various sizes to meet your needs. Our
[adjustable cartons](https://www.signet.net.au/packaging/boxes-containers/shipping-cartons/adjustable-carton.html)
provide a versatile solution, allowing you to modify the height as needed.
For fragile or heavy items, choose our
[heavy-duty cartons](https://www.signet.net.au/packaging/boxes-containers/shipping-cartons/heavy-duty-cartons.html)
reinforced with double-wall construction for maximum strength.

- **[Mailers](https://www.signet.net.au/packaging/mailroom-shipping/mail-bags.html):**
Choose from a variety of
[mail bags, postal satchels, and return mailers.](https://www.signet.net.au/packaging/mailroom-shipping/mail-bags.html)
Our range includes eco-friendly options like
[paper and compostable mailers](https://www.signet.net.au/packaging/mailroom-shipping/mail-bags/eco-friendly-mailers.html),
[poly mailers](https://www.signet.net.au/packaging/mailroom-shipping/mail-bags/poly-mailers.html),
[padded](https://www.signet.net.au/packaging/mailroom-shipping/mail-bags/padded-bags.html)
and
[bubble mailers.](https://www.signet.net.au/packaging/mailroom-shipping/mail-bags/bubble-bag.html)
- **[Packaging Tapes](https://www.signet.net.au/packaging/packaging-tapes-adhesives.html):**
Find the right adhesive type for your packing needs, including
water-activated, rubber adhesive, synthetic rubber adhesive, water-based
acrylic, and solvent-based acrylic. Opt for
[water-activated or paper packaging tape](https://www.signet.net.au/packaging/packaging-tapes-adhesives/hand-packaging-tape/paper-packing-tape.html)
for eco-friendly alternatives.

- **[Pallet Wraps & Stretch Films](https://www.signet.net.au/packaging/pallet-wrap-stretch-films.html):**
With over 55 years of expertise, Signet offers a wide range of
[pallet wrap solutions](https://www.signet.net.au/packaging/pallet-wrap-stretch-films.html), from
[hand pallet wrap](https://www.signet.net.au/packaging/pallet-wrap-stretch-films/hand-pallet-wrap.html)
to
[machine pallet wrap](https://www.signet.net.au/packaging/pallet-wrap-stretch-films/machine-pallet-wrap.html). Choose blown film for irregularly shaped or heavy loads, or cast pallet
wrap for a quiet, easy application.

- **[Protective Packaging](https://www.signet.net.au/packaging/protective-packaging.html):**
Keep your goods safe with
[Signet’s protective packaging](https://www.signet.net.au/packaging/protective-packaging.html). Choose from wrapping, void fill, and cushioning products like bubble
wrap, air pillows and
[Geami honeycomb wrapping paper](https://www.signet.net.au/packaging/protective-packaging/paper-protective-packaging/geami.html)
to ensure your items stay secure during shipping.

- **[Machinery](https://www.signet.net.au/packaging/machinery.html):** Automate your packaging process with our extensive range of
[machinery](https://www.signet.net.au/packaging/machinery.html), including
[carton sealers](https://www.signet.net.au/packaging/machinery/carton-sealer-erector.html),
[heat shrink machines](https://www.signet.net.au/packaging/machinery/heat-shrink.html), and
[strapping machines](https://www.signet.net.au/packaging/machinery/strapping-machine.html). Shop industry-leading brands like
[Ranpak](https://www.signet.net.au/packaging/machinery/ranpak-machine.html), Bosch, Lantech, and Signode.

- **[Eco-Friendly Packaging](https://www.signet.net.au/packaging/eco-friendly.html):**
Explore our range of
[sustainable packaging materials](https://www.signet.net.au/packaging/eco-friendly.html), including
[recyclable shipping boxes](https://www.signet.net.au/packaging/eco-friendly/packaging-supplies/sustainable-mailers-shipping-cartons.html),
[biodegradable protective packaging](https://www.signet.net.au/packaging/eco-friendly/packaging-supplies/void-fill-product-protection.html), and
[compostable mailers](https://www.signet.net.au/packaging/eco-friendly/packaging-supplies/compostable-mailers.html). Signet is committed to minimizing environmental impact with
eco-friendly solutions.


## [Safety & PPE](https://www.signet.net.au/safety-ppe.html)

Stay protected from head to toe with Signet’s high-quality
[Safety and Personal Protective Equipment](https://www.signet.net.au/safety-ppe.html). Explore our range of
[gloves](https://www.signet.net.au/safety-ppe/ppe-protective-wear/hand-protection.html),
[respiratory protection](https://www.signet.net.au/safety-ppe/ppe-protective-wear/respiratory-protection.html),

[ear plugs and earmuffs](https://www.signet.net.au/safety-ppe/ppe-protective-wear/ear-protection.html),
[safety vests](https://www.signet.net.au/safety-ppe/ppe-protective-wear/safety-vests.html), [warning signs](https://www.signet.net.au/safety-ppe/signs.html), and
more.


## [Cleaning & Janitorial](https://www.signet.net.au/cleaning-janitorial.html)

Keep your workplace clean and well-maintained with Signet’s essential
[cleaning supplies](https://www.signet.net.au/cleaning-janitorial.html).
Stock up on [hand towels and dispensers](https://www.signet.net.au/cleaning-janitorial/hand-towels-dispensers.html),
[toilet paper](https://www.signet.net.au/cleaning-janitorial/toilet-tissue-dispensers.html),
[cleaning chemicals](https://www.signet.net.au/cleaning-janitorial/cleaning-chemicals.html),
[garbage bags](https://www.signet.net.au/cleaning-janitorial/garbage-waste-removal.html), and more.


## [Marking & Aerosol Spray](https://www.signet.net.au/marking-aerosol-spray.html)

Locally made in Australia,
[Signet’s Own Field Marking Paints](https://www.signet.net.au/marking-aerosol-spray/field-turf-marking-paint.html)
are perfect for marking footy fields, cricket pitches, or outdoor events.
We also stock a wide range of
[line marking paints, road marking paints,](https://www.signet.net.au/marking-aerosol-spray/linemarking.html) [spot marking sprays](https://www.signet.net.au/marking-aerosol-spray/spot-marking-spray.html), and
[marking stencils and accessories.](https://www.signet.net.au/marking-aerosol-spray/stencilling-products.html)

## [Site Supplies](https://www.signet.net.au/site-supplies.html)

Signet caters to various industries with our
[industrial supplies](https://www.signet.net.au/site-supplies.html),
including survey, mining, and construction. Explore our range of

## [Office Supplies](https://www.signet.net.au/office-supplies.html)

Achieve your organization goals with
[Signet’s office supplies](https://www.signet.net.au/office-supplies.html).
Stock up on
[printing paper and notebooks](https://www.signet.net.au/office-supplies/copy-paper.html),
[stationery](https://www.signet.net.au/office-supplies/desktop-stationery.html),

## [Australia-Wide Delivery](https://www.signet.net.au/shipping-policy)

For over 55 years, Signet has been delivering the best products to our
customers quickly and efficiently. As the preferred supplier for many of
Australia’s largest manufacturing and packaging companies, we offer low

[Melbourne](https://www.signet.net.au/melbourne),

## OUR WEBSITE IS CURRENTLY UNDERGOING MAINTENANCE FOR A SHORT TIME

![](https://larplast.com/site/assets/files/1060/ser8930-v2.jpg)

### EXTRUSION LINE

In our production line, films are produced according to thermoform production plan in different sizes and changing between 35 cm to 120 cm in width, and between 200 micron to 1000 micron thickness. The product is performed in our line according to BRC/IOP version 6 quality production standards.

![](https://larplast.com/site/assets/files/1062/ser7856-v1.jpg)

### END TO END ENGINEERING PRODUCTION

Our team, following the domestic and foreign market trends with technology oriented studies, makes “special designs” for your needs. Our aim is to produce remarkable and proper products by using our creativity in every project.

![](https://larplast.com/site/assets/files/1058/ser7095-v1.jpg)

### THERMOFORM PRODUCT

Larplast manufactures disposable food containers, punnets and clamshells, blister packaging, separators and special projects with thermoforming method, since 1977. Mold and raw materials necessarily for these products within the company by getting support from extrusion line and tooling house.

In thermoform production PET, R-PET, PVC, PS, ABS, PP and PLA materials can be used in different thickness and colors.

We believe in new circular models, we embrace the transformation to a resource efficient and low-carbon society.

In this Walki Experts interview, Robert Björklind explains how advanced barrier lining solutions for solid and corrugated boards deliver protection with reduced plastic content, supporting recyclability and helping meet PPWR requirements across multiple applications.

[Watch the video](https://www.walki.com/experts/walki-line-sustainable-barrier-lining-solutions/)

![Walki Sustainability Report 2025](https://www.walki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/img_seo_CSR2025_1200x675.jpg)

Walki CSR 2025

Walki has published its Corporate Sustainability Report 2025, highlighting progress in circularity, climate action and sustainable innovation. To meet PPWR recyclability criteria, Walki has set up its own laboratory to test fibre-based packaging before launch or final validation by external bodies. This facility accelerates the assessment of coatings and reject rates, ensuring packaging is genuinely recyclable in real-world processes.

# Hi-Technology Group - ISO 13485 & JOSCAR Certified Injection Moulding Company

## Full-Service Contract Manufacturing

Hi-Technology Group is an ISO 13485 certified, JOSCAR registered plastic

injection moulding company with facilities in Waterlooville, Hampshire.

Named 3M EMEA Supplier of the Year, we manufacture plastic components and assemblies for medical, defence and safety-critical industries, including Chemring Countermeasures, Apollo Fire Detectors and Ocean Signal – with over 40 years of manufacturing experience.

[Learn More](https://www.hitechltd.com/full-contract-manufacturing/)

![Plastic Injection Moulding Company factor](https://www.hitechltd.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/LETYDRONOM_HI-TECHNOLOGY_SLOVAKIA_20250312_17.jpg)

## What Makes Us Different?

As an award winning injection moulding company we fully understand how we can best serve you. This not only covers your full product requirements and where you are in the development path but also all the needs and services around this which will make you successful and give you an easier life.

From the product side we can support your design optimisation from a very early stage and partner you on the development and productionisation journey from tooling, process, assembly and testing design to full manufacturing. For services, we help with material selection, component and electronics sourcing, guidance on best practice processes, through to tool servicing, [ultrasonic welding services](https://www.hitechltd.com/ultrasonic-welding-services/), logistics and long-term service agreements. We also support joint customer cost reduction programmes to optimise costs long term. We offer much more than just injection moulding!

[Learn About Us](https://www.hitechltd.com/about-us/)

## Our Services & Capabilities

As one of the best [plastic manufacturing companies in the UK](https://www.hitechltd.com/plastic-manufacturing-companies-in-the-uk/) we pride ourselves on being a full-service plastic injection moulding company committed to excellence at every stage of the manufacturing process.

With a focus on high-quality production, trust us to bring your vision to life with precision and care, as we see your achievements as our own.

### Quality Assurance

### Sourcing & Logistics

Over the last 40 years, our plastic injection moulding company has supported our clients with [injection moulding services](https://www.hitechltd.com/plastic-injection-moulding/), working in highly regulated industries with demanding medical, safety, aerospace, marine and defence-specific quality and process requirements.

## Welcome to  Emirates Printing Press

# Printing Press in Dubai

![Achievement Award 2024](https://www.eppdubai.com/images/ezgif.com-gif-maker.gif)

Emirates Printing Press (EPP) based in Dubai and operating since 1974 is the leading Printer of the region for [Packaging Folding Cartons & Rigid Set-up boxes](https://www.eppdubai.com/folding-carton-packaging.html), [Flexible Laminates](https://www.eppdubai.com/flexible-packaging/products/laminates.html) & [Pouches](https://www.eppdubai.com/flexible-packaging/products/pouches.html), [Self-adhesive & Wrap-around Labels and Commercials](https://www.eppdubai.com/flexible-packaging/products/shrink-sleeves.html).

EPP has 5 plants covering more than 750 000 Sq.ft, 800+ strong workforce, making us the largest printing company in UAE equipped with the latest technology in pre-press, press and post-press. With the state of the art facilities and huge production capacity in [Web & Sheet fed Offset, Sheet & Rotary Gravure](https://www.eppdubai.com/commercial-printing-press/printing-techniques.html), Flexographic presses available and every process taking place in-house, we assure clients of our best services with short turnaround time.

We specialize in producing high-quality Flexible Laminates & Pouches, Self-adhesive & Wrap-around Labels, Folding Cartons & Rigid setup boxes for Perfumes, Cosmetics, Confectionaries, FMCG, Pharmaceuticals and Tobacco customers around the globe. We also produce books, magazines, catalogs, annual reports, calendars, educational textbooks and election ballot papers with security features.

From our hub in Dubai, we service clients from Middle East, Africa, UK, Europe, USA and around the world. Our goal is to provide you with top-level service from the moment you walk in the door. Every job, from the point it enters our system, is handled with care and the attention to detail that our customers have come to expect of Emirates Printing Press, Dubai and which our professionals take pride in delivering.

When it comes to packaging automation, having equipment you can count on is a top priority. We understand that you have deadlines and throughput numbers that must be met, which means you can’t afford equipment failures or gaps in production. Therefore, partnering with a dependable packaging machine manufacturer is of the utmost importance. Reliable[industrial packaging machines](https://www.pmikyoto.com/packaging-machinery/by-machine/)make all the difference between meeting your output needs and coming up short. Many of our customers report their machines are still running efficiently after more than 20 years! From [case packers](https://www.pmikyoto.com/products/case-tray-packers/) to [vertical cartoners](https://www.pmikyoto.com/products/vertical-cartoners/), our team of engineers can design any type of end-of-line packaging solution to meet your needs. At PMI KYOTO, we’re more than just a packaging machinery supplier: We are a true partner you can rely on moving forward. ## Unpacking    the PMI KYOTO Story

PMI Cartoning was founded in Elk Grove Village, Illinois in 1993. As the company grew, a 100,000 sq. ft. manufacturing, engineering, and testing facility as well as a rebuild facility were constructed nearby. In 2017, Kyoto Seisakusho Co., Ltd., the #1 automated packaging equipment manufacturer in Japan, acquired PMI, giving us invaluable access to the robotic automation capabilities that are currently shaping the packaging world. Today, the former PMI Cartoningoperates in its original Elk Grove Village location as PMI KYOTO Packaging Systems.
